evidence.evidence_text: Cold-start active learning (CSAL) selects valuable instances from an unlabeled dataset for manual annotation.
Then, it constructs a Dual-Neighbor Graph (DNG) to combine information on both textual diversity and class diversity, ensuring a balanced data distribution.
Specifically, DEUCE leverages a pretrained language model (PLM) to efficiently extract textual representations, class predictions, and predictive uncertainty.
It further propagates uncertainty information via density-based clustering to select hard representative instances.
To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel dual-diversity enhancing and uncertainty-aware (DEUCE) framework for CSAL.
DEUCE performs well in selecting class-balanced and hard representative data by dual-diversity and informativeness.
